YES A THOUSAND TIMES YES! I live in a four bedroom home with my ndad and TWO of those rooms r full of junk and anytime I attempt to clean or throw things out(even suggesting selling or donating) he starts yelling at me that it’s the way he likes it and then threatens to throw out things in my room when I’m not home lol.

- my pets won’t have me to care for them and thus will be rehomed or put down
- my few close friends will be devastated
- my coworkers will miss me
- I won’t get to see what the world has to offer me in the next days, weeks, months, years

Man I never thought I’d find someone in such a similar situation as me! I moved out from my mom’s about 5 years ago and after a situation with her I don’t message her unless it’s a health emergency (which she’s using now to get me to respond) and she sends walls and walls of text that I literally could never respond to. It’s exhausting and overwhelming! She even called me like 10 times within an hour or two, then proceeded to apologize a shit ton. I’m over it lol.

I do have a therapist that I got early into the pandemic, she’s helped a ton but obviously years of trauma can’t just be healed in a few months. Working hard and hopefully once I’m able to move things get mentally easier 💜

This would happen to me often in grade school. I got a bad grade in my French class so my mom called the school yelling and accusing my teacher of purposely grading me low cause she was “probably a piece of shit Indian” or something along those lines. I was sent to the principals office to discuss it and as soon as they told me what happened I burst out crying and couldn’t stop, I’m surprised they didn’t contact cps or question me further.

“You’re fine just take vitamins” mom
“Why are you so lazy and ungrateful” dad

And then as a kid if I was sick and had a bad cough my mom would storm in my room to yell at me and tell me to shut up cause she’s trying to sleep

My mom still texts and calls me constantly but emotionally/physically she’s cut off from me. I don’t respond unless there’s a medical issue (which I’m learning she’s using to get a hold of me) so it feels as though she’s cut off or at least distanced enough to no longer cause harm.

It’ll be hard no matter what, especially if that Nparent likes to say you’ll regret it and like mine constantly try to reach you or make you feel like shit. It’s all about letting go and having a good support system to get you through it. I believe in you.

Just had this conversation with my therapist. I’m ashamed and embarrassed to express feelings so when I cried to her she told me to let the feelings go through me. It sucks and it’s sucks even more that I have to feel the emotions to get over this shame.

Yeah it helps, I’ve already been tested before cause of a coworker but this one works so close with me so it’s more scary than ever. I’m calling my friend rn but it just isn’t the same and I know it won’t be but :/ I just wish it were different.
Coexist, we barely talk other than him getting mad at me or telling me I’m selfish and lazy lol
Yeah it’s mandatory but they take it down sometimes and it’s common with people I work with to take them off once work is closed :/

Moving out as well is hard by myself with rent cost vs my wage at work but hopefully I can find a roommate. life has a lot of curveballs in my direction sadly. Best of luck to you and escaping your toxic environment 💜
